prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last year I was bouncing around Beijing a lot, and I remember casually browsing restaurants there just to kill time.
One night I ended up at this place called Imperial Kitchen—pretty sure that’s the name that popped up everywhere back then.
Funny thing is my friend Zhang Wei had already booked it for 2025-03-16 at 19:00, so I didn’t do anything except show up.
It was just me at the table—party size 1—and he used 13871016229 on the reservation, which I only noticed because the SMS was on his phone.
Around that same time in Beijing I was also comparing home service options people talk about, plus I’d been reading random stuff on medicine and books—kind of a messy phase.

My cousin Chen Ming was the organized one—he’d already enrolled in Data Structures and Algorithms, and he even had a home service booked for 2025-03-23 at 14:00 to Room 295, Building A, East District, using 13833841705.
